summaries.class:scalive.FormEventMeta: Logical target plus the original browser path, optional raw submitter evidence, metadata, and diagnostics for a typed form event.
summaries.class:scalive.FormLimits: Resource bounds applied while projecting untrusted payloads into semantic form values.
summaries.class:scalive.FormSubmitter: Definition-owned finite actions rendered and decoded through native form submit controls.
summaries.class:scalive.RawFormSubmitter: Untrusted name and value metadata for a successful form submit control.
summaries.class:scalive.HttpFormDecoder: Bounded decoder for CSRF-protected, URL-encoded ordinary HTTP forms.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.Error.code: Returns a stable low-cardinality rejection code for logs and metrics.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.Error.toResp: Maps transport and security rejection categories to conservative HTTP responses.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.decode: Bounds and decodes a URL-encoded body, validates CSRF, then applies form decoding.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.respond: Runs decoded handling and centralizes conservative rejection responses.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.urlEncoded: Builds a bounded CSRF-protected decoder for a typed definition or low-level codec.
summaries.def:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.urlEncodedVa: Builds a decoder that requires a valid typed domain value.
summaries.enum:scalive.HttpFormDecoder.Error: Typed body, representation, CSRF, and validation rejection categories.
summaries.object:scalive.HttpFormDecoder: Constructors and typed rejection categories for ordinary HTTP form decoders.
summaries.val:scalive.FormData.raw: Every submitted textual name-value pair in original encounter order, including duplicates.
summaries.val:scalive.FormEventMeta.browserTarget: Original protocol-level form path, including compatibility-layer spelling.
summaries.val:scalive.FormEventMeta.diagnostics: Non-fatal target and compatibility translation diagnostics.
summaries.val:scalive.FormEventMeta.metadata: Additional event metadata supplied by the client protocol.
summaries.val:scalive.FormEventMeta.rawSubmitter: Untrusted submit control metadata supplied by the client protocol, when available.
summaries.val:scalive.FormEventMeta.target: Definition-resolved stable logical address of the changed field, when available.
summaries.val:scalive.FormLimits.maxErrors: Maximum number of projection and validation errors retained for one event.
summaries.val:scalive.FormLimits.maxPathDepth: Maximum accepted nesting depth for one submitted form path.
summaries.val:scalive.FormLimits.maxRowsPerGroup: Maximum number of repeated rows retained in one group.
summaries.val:scalive.FormLimits.maxSegmentLength: Maximum accepted character length for one form-path segment.
summaries.val:scalive.FormLimits.maxValuesPerField: Maximum number of raw values retained for one declared field.
summaries.val:scalive.FormSubmitter.name: Browser field name shared by controls rendered from this typed submitter.
